Better ones out there.. I bought two different brands of face paint pallets that were same price. This one came with some cracks in the paint cakes and some chunks floating around in the containers, not too big of deal I guess. But when using the paint, yikes, not good. They were not very opaque. Had a hard time getting them to apply in a decent fashion. This one definitely lost over the other pallet. The plus side is, it does come with some sticker stencils, and a pack of wipes and paint brushes. For it being so cheap, that does help make up a little bit for the quality. I would not but this one again though

Meh. I purchased this product after using it at Chateau Elan spa and resort and loved it, but when I received it it was much drier than what I used previously. It's not the best in terms of smoothness and fragrance

Ridiculous Packaging and Expires In Two Weeks!. I just received these and I'm very disappointed. I ordered two 60 count packages. The two packages were taped together with wide packing tape. When I removed the tape the label came off and the adhesive stayed on the packages. The packages are extremely sticky and now everything in my bathroom will stick to them. The second part that disappoints me is that they expire in two weeks! I have 120 wipes that will be two years old in two weeks, which I'm assuming will render the vitamin C ineffective or worse, possible bacteria formation. As far as I'm concerned, this was not something that was overlooked, this was on purpose

Wouldn't recommend for sensitive skin. This product was recommended to me but I personally don't like it. I have clear skin so I don't really use foundation(unless a get a pimple) but I do like to use eyeshadow and eyeliner a lot. It doesn't take off the makeup well. Aside from holding the tissue in place for a few seconds on the eyes, you have to press and drag hard to be able to take off the makeup or it just won't come off well. I have REALLY sensitive skin and my skin did NOT like that. The skin around my eyelids are really irritated after taking the eyeshadow off to the point it hurts to touch it. It's not gentle on the skin at all even if you try to be gentle with it. But guess what? if you're gentle most of the makeup won't come off so it's a lose-lose situation. By the time you're done you've used quite a lot of tissues and that's just the eyes.... I've tried so many methods thinking that maybe I was doing it wrong before but I keep getting the same results
